tax.name: GST
tax.note: Two main slabs, 5% and 18%, and 40% for a few goods, since 22 September 2025 (GST 2.0); 0% for exempt supplies. Hotel rooms up to 7,500 rupees a night are 5%, above that 18%. The old 12% and 28% are still accepted on saved documents. Checked against news and tax-advisory pages, not the CBIC notification itself.
